headline: Nevish Line Sealed; Two Warden Works Go to No-Man's-Land
war_summary: The Nevish Line is closed. The last unclaimed work there has passed to the Colonials, who now stand eight of eight, though the guns have cooled — a dozen actions in six hours and none in the last two. The Weathered Expanse remains the hottest quarter on the map: a Warden work there has gone to no-man's-land, leaving six Warden and three unclaimed, with fighting running to the hour of this edition about Shattered Advance, Crow's Nest, Huntsfort and Wightwalk, and thirty-four actions in the day. Marban Hollow has likewise yielded a Warden work to no-man's-land and now reads three Warden, three Colonial and two unclaimed; Checkpoint Bua alone accounts for sixteen actions, the sector firing again within the last quarter-hour. Callahan's Passage stands wholly Warden at ten and has fallen quiet. Linn Mercy holds at ten Colonial and one unclaimed after thirty-nine actions. Mooring County remains ten Warden to two Colonial, with the heaviest blood of the watch — above two thousand Colonial and fifteen hundred Warden casualties in two hours. At Callum's Cape a Colonial stroke at Scouts Jest leaves that sector six Warden to one Colonial, casualties climbing fast. Colonials hold the greater part of the map.
